newsitem.title: USA: NAPM - New York business conditions 72.9 in December.
newsitem.headline: NAPM - New York business conditions 72.9 in December.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions rose to 72.9 in December from 64.9 in November.
"The December reading was the strongest pace since the survey began in May 1993," said a report issued with the index.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index climbed to 74.4 in December from 63.1 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions slipped to 59.1 from 81.1, the lowest reading since April, the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
"Purchasers in the New York area reported that overall business conditions grew at a strong pace in December," NAPM said.
The prices paid component of the index rose to 49.0 in December after falling to 47.0 the month before.
NAPM's New York business outlook index read 71.6 in December, just below November's 71.9 reading.
"Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimisim remained high," NAPM said.
